column1: # The reserved '#%' prologue keys of a run manifest: what a capture should
# carry so that a result can be traced to the requirement it tests, the build
# it measured and the run that produced it. 'provost check-manifest' reports
# the captures missing a required key; '--manifest FILE' and
# '--manifest-profile NAME' check a capture as it is filed.
#   key          letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; starts with a letter or '_'
#   when         run  = known when the run happens: belongs in the prologue
#                post = decided after the run (a review): added later with
#                       'provost annotate ID KEY=VALUE', and checked only by
#   required     yes = a capture without it (or with it empty) is reported
#                no  = reserved name, documented, never demanded
# A store can use another profile (a copy of this file, edited) by keeping it
# as manifest-profile.tsv at the store's root; PROVOST_MANIFEST_PROFILE or
# --manifest-profile names one for a single run.

column4: requirement this run gives evidence for (an RVTM or requirement id)
the test or benchmark that was run
version of that test or benchmark
source commit of the software under test
sha256 of the binary that ran
scheduler job id (Slurm, PBS, ...) the run was part of
id of the run, as the launcher (e.g. quarterdeck) gave it
system under test: the host, cluster or partition measured
a recorded departure from the test procedure ("none" if none)
the review's verdict (e.g. pass, fail, retest, waived)
